verdicts.evidence: SENSITIVITY CONTROL: `(.+)` is GREEDY and `.` matches neither \n nor \r, so the match already terminates exactly at the first line terminator; `$` under /m only asserts the position the greedy quantifier has necessarily already reached. Make the quantifier lazy — `(.+?)` — and the two diverge at once, `U` against `Use one queue`. That is the input shape that would separate them, and it is not the shape the source has. Measured byte-identical across nine probe missions, including a CRLF-authored ADR, which is the case where a naive reading expects `$` to matter (it does not: `.` cannot cross the \r either).
